description: Chat completions with the exact request and response shape of the OpenAI API: point your existing client at this URL and it works, no code change. One flat price per call whatever the size of the prompt or the answer — no token metering, no API key, no account, no rate limit. Automatic failover across several large models, so a model being down is not your problem. You are only charged if the completion is delivered. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

max_tokens.description: Output token cap, up to 4000. Does not change the price.

messages.description: The conversation, as in the OpenAI API: [{"role":"system|user|assistant","content":"..."}]. In a POST, send it as a real JSON array, exactly as an OpenAI client does; in a GET, pass that same JSON as text in the query string. Both are accepted.

model.description: Ignored on purpose: the service picks the model and fails over between several. Accepted so an OpenAI client can send it unchanged.

prompt.description: Shortcut for a single user message, if you do not want to build the array.

temperature.description: Passed through to the model when given.

name: chat_completions
title: OpenAI-compatible chat completions
